change.title: pr-10
change.description: FEATURE: Can edit category/host relationships for embedding
change.author: Robin Ward

findings.title: Migration raises when no `embed_category` setting row exists (the default)
findings.body: The first query joins `site_settings` on `name = 'embed_category'`. `embed_category` defaults to `''` in config/site_settings.yml, so a fresh install or any site that never changed it has no such row. The query then returns an empty `PG::Result`, and `[0]['id']` is called on it. As far as I know, `PG::Result#[]` raises `IndexError` for an out-of-range row. The same happens if the stored category name matches no category. The `if category_id == 0` fallback on line 14 is never reached in those cases, so `db:migrate` aborts on exactly the installs that never configured embedding. The `embeddable_hosts` lookup below guards with `cmd_tuples > 0`, but this one does not. Fix: use `.first`/`cmd_tuples` and handle nil. Do the same for the `uncategorized_category_id` query on line 15.

findings.title: Migrated hosts are inserted raw, so previously valid entries stop matching
findings.body: The old setting allowed entries such as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`; the old spec in spec/models/site_setting_spec.rb exercised them. The migration inserts each line verbatim. The scheme/path stripping lives only in the model's `before_validation` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-8), which raw SQL bypasses. `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host) = uri.host` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17), so a stored `http://discourse.org` can never match. After migrating, those sites silently lose embedding. Other problems with the same line: `split("\n")` keeps a trailing `\r` and whitespace-only or blank lines become rows. The unescaped `'#{h}'` interpolation breaks on a quote. Strip the scheme, path and whitespace, skip blanks, and use `quote`/`ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote` in the migration.

findings.title: Feed-polled topics lose their category when the feed URL's host is not an embeddable host
findings.body: `SiteSetting.embed_category` applied to every import. The category now comes only from `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)`, and `eh.try(:category_id)` is nil when the host is not registered. `TopicEmbed.import` is also called from app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:39 with the feed item's URL, and the feed is not required to be on an embeddable host. Those topics now land in Uncategorized. Please confirm this is intended, or fall back to a default category. The migration has the same gap: it copies the old category only onto the old hosts.

findings.title: Missing record or params give a 500 instead of 404/422
findings.body: `update` and `destroy` use `where(id:).first`, so an unknown id (for example one already deleted in another tab) gives `nil` and a `NoMethodError` on `host.destroy`/`save_host(nil)`. `save_host` also raises on a missing `params[:embeddable_host]`. A nil `host` reaches the model's `before_validation` (`self.host.sub!`, app/models/embeddable_host.rb:6) and raises there too. Use `find` (mapped to 404 by the app) and `params.require(:embeddable_host)`. `category_id` is also not checked to exist, so a bad id is saved and the host then has `category` nil.

findings.title: Edit buffer is never committed after save, so re-editing shows what was typed, not what was stored
findings.body: After `host.save(props)` succeeds, the buffer still holds the typed value and is not committed or rolled back. The server normalises the host (`http://foo.com/x` becomes `foo.com`). The read-only row shows `host.host`, but the next `edit` shows the stale buffered `http://foo.com/x` in the input. Call `commitBuffer()`/`rollbackBuffer()` on success. The delete path on lines 46-48 has no `.catch`, so a failed DELETE leaves the row with no feedback; add `.catch(popupAjaxError)`.

findings.title: `update` persists nothing, and `saveChanges` is unused
findings.body: `update` just re-renders the OpenStruct. The client `saveChanges` action (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6:5-7) calls `update({})` but nothing in embedding.hbs triggers it. Hosts are saved through their own controller. Remove the dead PUT route, `update` action and `saveChanges`, or implement them. The unused `edit` key in client.en.yml is also dead.

findings.title: A host with a port passes validation but can never match
findings.body: The format regex accepts `(:[0-9]{1,5})?`, but `record_for_host` compares against `uri.host`, which excludes the port (line 14-17). An admin who enters `example.com:8080` gets a saved row that never allows anything. Either reject ports in the regex or match on `host:port`.

findings.title: `*_ids` hydration can yield undefined entries and throws on a non-array
findings.body: The plural branch maps `obj[k]` without checking it is an array. A null `foo_ids` throws, and the `hydrated || []` fallback on line 200 is dead because `map` always returns an array. An id missing from the side-loaded collection becomes an `undefined` array element. The regex now applies to every `__rest_serializer` payload (queued_posts and similar_topics also use it), not only the new embedding one. Guard with `Ember.isArray` and drop unresolved ids.

findings.title: Fabricator file contents are swapped between the two files
findings.body: `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator.rb` now defines `:embeddable_host`. `spec/fabricators/embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` defines `:category`, `:diff_category`, `:happy_category` and `:private_category`. It still works because Fabrication loads every file, but it is misleading. Revert category_fabricator.rb and put the `:embeddable_host` fabricator in embeddable_host_fabricator.rb.

findings.title: Test no longer tests what its name says
findings.body: `expandable_first_post?` no longer depends on embeddable hosts (app/models/topic.rb:869). 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' has no stubs, so it passes only because `has_topic_embed?` is false. Rename or remove it. The describe on line 1407 has the typo 'emeddable'. Separately, the removed host check is a behaviour change: a topic with an embed and `embed_truncate` is now expandable even with no hosts configured.

findings.title: `find('fruit', 2)` asserts data for fruit 1
findings.body: The pretender handler `/fruits/:id` ignores the id and always returns `fruits[0]` (test/javascripts/helpers/create-pretender.js.es6:226-228). The test asks for id 2 (banana, `color_ids: [3]`) but asserts two colors with ids 1 and 2, which are apple's. It passes only by accident. Request id 1, or make the handler honour the id.

findings.title: Admin controllers only tested for their superclass
findings.body: The new create/update/destroy and embedding show actions have no request specs. Nothing covers authorisation for non-admin staff, the blank category fallback, validation errors or a missing id. The migration has no spec either.

contracts.action: Migration copies the `embeddable_hosts` and `embed_category` settings into the new table, then deletes both setting rows
contracts.equivalent_path: EmbeddableHost model before_validation normalisation (app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-8) and the old SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? matching
contracts.before_after: Before: hosts lived in one setting, which allowed scheme/path entries and was matched after stripping `http(s)://`. After: rows are inserted raw by SQL, skipping normalisation, and matched by exact host in `record_for_host`.
contracts.visible_effect: Sites whose list had `http://` or path entries lose embedding. A site with no `embed_category` row fails the migration.
contracts.failure_mode: The first query raises on an empty result and the migration aborts. The DELETE removes only the two named settings and runs after the inserts, so a rollback restores them only if the whole migration runs in a transaction.

contracts.action: Admin deletes a host (client `destroyRecord` then server `host.destroy`)
contracts.equivalent_path: Other admin REST delete flows via RestAdapter.destroyRecord (e.g. permalinks)
contracts.before_after: Before: embeddable_hosts was a setting. After: DELETE /admin/embeddable_hosts/:id removes the row for the id the client sends, after a bootbox confirm. The id comes from the row the admin clicked.
contracts.visible_effect: The row disappears from the table only on success, via the `deleteHost` action. Nothing else is deleted.
contracts.failure_mode: A missing id gives a 500 (`nil.destroy`) and the promise rejects with no `.catch`, so the failure is silent and the row stays. No other state is lost.

contracts.action: Admin adds or edits a host (store.createRecord then `host.save`)
contracts.before_after: Types `embeddable-host` (created) and `embeddable_host` (hydrated) both resolve to /admin/embeddable_hosts through the `replace('_','-')` change in basePath, and the typeField is `embeddable_host` in both cases. The save sends `{host, category_id}` and the server returns `embeddable_host`.
contracts.visible_effect: The row leaves edit mode and the category badge is set from `Category.findById`. The server-normalised host shows in the read-only row.
contracts.failure_mode: Validation errors go through `popupAjaxError`. The buffer keeps the typed value after success, so re-editing shows stale text.

contracts.action: Embed access check now uses EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?
contracts.before_after: Before: a blank setting was rejected, then the referer host was compared with stripped entries. After: a parameterised `lower(host) = ?` DB lookup on `URI(referer).host`. A blank table or a nil/bad referer returns false and raises InvalidAccess.
contracts.visible_effect: Same allow/deny for hosts without ports. Entries with ports never match.
contracts.failure_mode: No referer or an unparsable one is rescued to false, so access is denied.

contracts.action: TopicEmbed.import picks the topic category from the matching embeddable host
contracts.equivalent_path: Old `SiteSetting.embed_category`, applied to all imports (embed requests and poll_feed)
contracts.before_after: Before: one global category. After: per-host category, nil when the URL's host is unregistered. A nil category leaves PostCreator with no category, so the topic goes to the default.
contracts.visible_effect: Feed-polled topics from a non-embeddable host lose their category.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent fallback to uncategorized; no error or log.
contracts.open_question: Is it intended that poll_feed imports for hosts not in embeddable_hosts go uncategorized?

summary: The PR replaces the `embeddable_hosts` and `embed_category` site settings with an `embeddable_hosts` table and an admin UI. The migration has two problems. It raises when there is no `embed_category` row, which is the default and so affects fresh installs. It also copies old hosts unnormalised, so `http://`/path entries that used to work can no longer match. Smaller points: poll_feed imports from hosts not in the table now land uncategorized; the admin controller returns 500 on a missing id; the edit buffer is never committed after save; and ports are accepted but can never match. The fabricator files have swapped contents, and two tests no longer test what their names say (`topic_spec.rb`, `store-test.js.es6`). The admin controllers have no real specs. The rest of the JS and Ember wiring (adapter path, type-name handling, serializer, routes) checks out.
